text:
laura_sales: Quick triage //- AzureBay wants to POC their in-house model 'azurebay-orbit-30b' for convo + RAG. They sent HF tar + tokenizer.json and claim 16k context. Can SE/infra/security confirm compatibility and call out blockers?
tom_se: Do we have the HF format details? Any special ops (rotary/ALiBi)?
laura_sales: HF tar contains pytorch weights, tokenizer.json, config. They say model trained with rotary.
tom_se: Rotary is OK. 16k context is supported but depends on kv packing and attention implementation. SE plan: tokenizer sanity check, build 8-bit and 4-bit variants, run their 150-query eval, perf sweep at ctx=2k/8k/16k. ETA ~3 business days after artifacts staged.
rafael_infra: Infra note: 30b @ 4-bit + 16k KV -> per-request KV ~1.5-2.5GB. For steady concurrency >5 prefer Dedicated with 2x A100-80GB or 4x A40. Hosted isolated single node possible for low concurrency. Sharding adds complexity.
nina_security: Security: need license provenance and SCA scan. If license restricts redistribution Hosted multi-tenant is blocked. For Hosted we require isolated tenant + KMS envelope; Private avoids many blockers. Also DPA required if PII is involved.
laura_sales: Pricing ask: rough POC numbers for Hosted isolated and Dedicated week?
tom_se: Ballpark: Hosted isolated sandbox ~= $3k/day (includes ops), Dedicated min-week (2x A100 reserved) ~= $20k-24k/week, variant validation fee ~= $1,200 one-time. Finance quote needed.
rafael_infra: Note: if they use external vector DB for RAG, include egress and auth integration in plan; can affect latency.
tom_se: High-risk summary for email: 1) License/provenance may block Hosted, 2) tokenizer mismatch (rare) could add ~1 day, 3) 16k KV increases infra footprint at concurrency >5 (may force Dedicated).
laura_sales: Great  I'll request staging link, eval set, and license docs. Tom  please watch the staging bucket and start builds when they upload.
ticket-bot: Created SE-5010 "AzureBay azurebay-orbit-30b POC variant & perf" assigned to tom_se, due 2024-11-12.
